parity_gaps.linux: native Linux system-call entry and implementation
parity_gaps.lxp: Linux-ABI guest request crosses into the LXP coordinator/host implementation
parity_gaps.evidence: LXP counted 171745 SVC calls; 5260 cycles average at 216 MHz implies approximately 4.18 seconds or 1.39% of one CPU over 300 seconds under a simple attribution model.
parity_gaps.consequence: The crossing is real, but the measured order of magnitude cannot explain the observed 2.9x SQLite, 9.7x network, or 3.3x FPS advantage for LXP. Do not treat syscall path alone as a material Linux advantage.
Instruction fetch, lookup and memory pressure differ; neither benchmark database is on root.

parity_gaps.linux: priority-99 SCHED_FIFO kernel thread on PREEMPT_RT Linux
parity_gaps.physical_contract: both use TIM3 CH1 on Arduino D3/PB4 and response GPIO on Arduino D4/PG7
parity_gaps.consequence: PREEMPT_RT reduces Linux misses greatly but its mean dispatch remains 43.7 times the LXP after-snapshot mean.

parity_gaps.linux: persistent worker with a 448 KiB fixed heap required by 8 MiB NOMMU contiguous-allocation limits
parity_gaps.consequence: SQL, durability, transaction and validation rules match; allocator/process overhead does not.
